raiz.texto: Ondrel demands strict performance of the contracted conduit volumes through the full term and an enforceable compensation formula for estuary salinity damage tied to measured river flow. It will not accept a Phase II design that diverts contracted export water to Vireya's reservoirs, and warns that collapsing Tessaran harvests would push migration into its port districts beyond what its housing and services can absorb. It conditions any continued conduit operation on these guarantees.
